home.heroSubhead: Harness enterprise-grade ASIC computing power hosted in MineBest's world-class data centers. Earn automated daily Bitcoin rewards for 1,500 days with zero hardware setup or electricity headaches.
home.clusterSubtitle: 84,000+ Online ASIC Units • Cold-Climate Evaporative Airflow • 99.98% Uptime
home.howItWorksTitle: Start Mining Bitcoin in 3 Simple Steps
home.howItWorksSubtitle: We've removed all the technical friction of crypto mining so anyone can participate effortlessly.
home.step1Desc: Select the computing package that fits your goals, from starter $100 contracts up to $30,000 industrial tiers.
home.step2Desc: MineBest engineers deploy and configure top-tier ASIC miners in our climate-optimized, 24/7 guarded data centers.
home.step3Desc: Enjoy automated daily Bitcoin distributions straight to your wallet for up to 1,500 consecutive days.
home.whyChooseSubtitle: A modern, user-first cloud mining ecosystem built on audited hardware and predictable reward systems.
home.feat1Desc: Forget manual clicking or complex software setups. After contract activation and 48h hardware calibration, daily Bitcoin yield is credited automatically every 24 hours.
home.feat2Desc: One of the longest contract lifecycles in the entire crypto industry. Your ASIC computing capacity continues mining through all seasons, backed by full hardware maintenance.
home.feat3Desc: Share your personal link and earn an instant 10% cash reward credited directly to your USDT balance whenever your downline purchases a mining package.
home.feat4Desc: Pair volume from your Left (A) and Right (B) legs. Every 1,000 USDT matched volume earns you 100 USDT, automatically settled every single night at 23:59 server time.
home.infraSubtitle: Our cloud contracts are underpinned by physical, high-performance ASIC rigs operating in Tier-III data centers with institutional-grade power management.
home.card1Desc: Thousands of high-density ASIC units in engineered hot/cold aisle containment, monitored by real-time IoT thermal sensors with automated exhaust.
home.card2Desc: Custom-tuned WhatsMiner M30S+ and Antminer S19 Pro units with dual high-CFM cooling fans and 5nm/7nm silicon for maximum hash consistency.
home.card3Desc: Direct 110kV-to-10kV step-down transformers connected to wholesale power plants, securing ultra-low electricity tariffs and 99.98% operational uptime.
home.aboutP1: Founded in 2017 by tech visionary Eyal Avramovich, MineBest has grown into one of the world's most trusted operators of industrial-scale cryptocurrency mining data centers.
home.aboutP2: Headquartered in Warsaw, Poland, MineBest engineers proprietary 20ft and 40ft all-weather high-density mobile mining containers. These units operate in strategic low-cost energy zones with cold-climate natural cooling, achieving an industry-leading Power Usage Effectiveness (PUE) of 1.08.
home.aboutP3: Through official procurement partnerships with MicroBT (WhatsMiner) and Bitmain (Antminer), MineBest delivers reliable, institutional-grade hashpower directly to BTCM members.
home.kazakhDesc: Direct high-voltage substation grid powering over 84,000 ASIC miners across 80 proprietary containers. Naturally cooled by sub-zero winter temperatures.
home.polandDesc: Engineering headquarters designing custom 40ft Smart Containers, remote telemetry IoT boards, and AI-driven thermal airflow management.
home.calcSubtitle: Select a package to see projected computing power and automated 1,500-day Bitcoin output calculated at live market rates.
home.faqSubtitle: Clear answers to common questions about cloud mining, rewards, and our infrastructure.
home.faqQ1: Do I need to buy any physical equipment or know how to code?
home.faqA1: No! That is the beauty of cloud mining. MineBest owns, hosts, and maintains all industrial ASIC rigs in certified data centers. You simply choose your computing power, and our automated system deposits Bitcoin directly to your wallet every day.
home.faqQ2: How long do mining contracts last?
home.faqA2: Every cloud mining contract runs for 1,500 consecutive days. After a 48-hour hardware diagnostics and burn-in period, automated daily Bitcoin mining distributions begin without requiring manual harvest.
home.faqQ3: How does the 10% Direct Bonus and Binary Pairing work?
home.faqA3: When someone joins using your referral link and activates a mining package, you instantly earn a 10% cash reward credited in USDT. In addition, our binary pairing engine pairs Leg A and Leg B volume every night at 23:59, awarding 100 USDT per 1,000 pair volume.
home.faqQ4: Which cryptocurrencies can I deposit and withdraw?
home.faqA4: We support USDT (TRC-20 & ERC-20), USDC, and native Bitcoin (BTC). Deposits credit automatically upon blockchain confirmation, and withdrawals can be requested anytime from your dashboard.
home.faqQ5: Who is MineBest and where are the data centers located?
home.faqA5: MineBest was founded in 2017 by Eyal Avramovich and is headquartered in Warsaw, Poland. The company operates over 300+ MW of high-density cryptographic data centers in Kazakhstan (Ekibastuz mega-hub) and Poland, partnering directly with MicroBT and Bitmain.
home.bottomCtaTitle: Ready to Power Your Bitcoin Future?
home.bottomCtaSubtitle: Join thousands of miners worldwide utilizing MineBest's institutional computing containers with guaranteed 1,500-day automated payouts.
home.footerDesc: Institutional-grade Bitcoin cloud mining powered by MineBest data centers. 1,500-day hardware lifecycles with daily automated payouts.
